Within each\n200\t/// message, repeated section groups (3–7) produce multiple fields.\n201\tpub fn decode_bytes(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<Field>> {\n202\t    let mut fields = Vec::new();\n203\t    let mut pos = 0;\n204\t\n205\t    while pos < bytes.len() {\n206\t        // Peek at next 4 bytes: expect \"GRIB\".\n207\t        if bytes.len() - pos < 4 {\n208\t            break;\n209\t        }\n210\t        if &bytes[pos..pos + 4] != b\"GRIB\" {\n211\t            return Err(Error::BadMagic(bytes[pos..pos + 4].try_into().unwrap()));\n212\t        }\n213\t\n214\t        let msg_len = decode_message(&bytes[pos..], &mut fields)?;\n215\t        pos += msg_len;\n216\t    }\n217\t\n218\t    Ok(fields)\n219\t}\n220\t\n221\t/// Decode one GRIB2 message (starting at byte 0 of `msg`).\n222\t/// Returns the number of bytes consumed (the total message length).\n223\tfn decode_message(msg: &[u8], out: &mut Vec<Field>) -> Result<usize> {\n224\t    let mut buf = Buf::new(msg);\n225\t\n226\t    // ── Section 0 (Indicator, 16 bytes fixed) ────────────────────────────────\n227\t    // oct 1-4: \"GRIB\"\n228\t    let magic = [buf.read_u8()?, buf.read_u8()?, buf.read_u8()?, buf.read_u8()?];\n229\t    if &magic != b\"GRIB\" {\n230\t        return Err(Error::BadMagic(magic));\n231\t    }\n232\t    buf.skip(2)?; // reserved\n233\t    let discipline = buf.read_u8()?;\n234\t    let edition = buf.read_u8()?;\n235\t    if edition != 2 {\n236\t        return Err(Error::UnknownEdition(edition));\n237\t    }\n238\t    let total_len = buf.read_u64be()? as usize;\n239\t    // Section 0 is now consumed (16 bytes).\n240\t\n241\t    // Validate total length against buffer.\n242\t    if msg.len() < total_len {\n243\t        return Err(Error::TooShort { needed: total_len, got: msg.len() });\n244\t    }\n245\t\n246\t    // ── Section iterator (sections 1-7 + \"7777\") ─────────────────────────────\n247\t    let mut builder = FieldBuilder::default();\n248\t\n249\t    // The message body ends just before the \"7777\" end marker.\n250\t    let body_end = total_len - 4;\n251\t\n252\t    while buf.pos < body_end {\n253\t        // Each section starts with: 4-byte length, 1-byte section number.\n254\t        let sec_start = buf.pos;\n255\t        let sec_len = buf.read_u32be()? as usize;\n256\t        let sec_num = buf.read_u8()?;\n257\t\n258\t        if sec_len < 5 {\n259\t            return Err(Error::TooShort { needed: 5, got: sec_len });\n260\t        }\n261\t        // Remaining bytes in this section (after the 5-byte header).\n262\t        let body_start = buf.pos;\n263\t        let body_len = sec_len - 5;\n264\t        let sec_body = &msg[body_start..body_start + body_len];\n265\t\n266\t        match sec_num {\n267\t            1 => {\n268\t                let (center, subcenter, ref_time) = parse_section1(sec_body)?;\n269\t                builder.center = Some(center);\n270\t                builder.subcenter = Some(subcenter);\n271\t                builder.ref_time = Some(ref_time);\n272\t            }\n273\t            2 => { /* Local Use section — skip */ }\n274\t            3 => {\n275\t                let (gdt, grid) = parse_section3(sec_body)?;\n276\t                builder.gdt_template = Some(gdt);\n277\t                builder.grid = Some(grid);\n278\t            }\n279\t            4 => {\n280\t                let (pdt, param, fore, lvl, ens) = parse_section4(sec_body, discipline)?;\n281\t                builder.pdt_template = Some(pdt);\n282\t                builder.parameter = Some(param);\n283\t                builder.forecast = Some(fore);\n284\t                builder.level = Some(lvl);\n285\t                builder.ensemble = Some(ens);\n286\t            }\n287\t            5 => {\n288\t                let (drt, packing, complex_extra, n_packed) = parse_section5(sec_body)?;\n289\t                builder.drt_template = Some(drt);\n290\t                builder.packing = Some(packing);\n291\t                builder.complex_extra = complex_extra;\n292\t                builder.n_packed = Some(n_packed);\n293\t            }\n294\t            6 => {\n295\t                let (has_bitmap, bitmap) = parse_section6(sec_body)?;\n296\t                builder.has_bitmap = Some(has_bitmap);\n297\t                builder.bitmap = bitmap;\n298\t            }\n299\t            7 => {\n300\t                let n_grid = builder.grid.as_ref().map(|g| g.num_data_points as usize).unwrap_or(0);\n301\t                let has_bitmap = builder.has_bitmap.unwrap_or(false);\n302\t                // When a bitmap is present, Section 5 n_packed < n_grid. Use n_packed\n303\t                // for the data unpackers (which only see the \"present\" subset).\n304\t                let n_decode = if has_bitmap {\n305\t                    builder.n_packed.unwrap_or(n_grid)\n306\t                } else {\n307\t                    n_grid\n308\t                };\n309\t                let packing = builder.packing.as_ref().ok_or(Error::NotImplemented)?;\n310\t                let drt = builder.drt_template.unwrap_or(0);\n311\t                let packed_values = decode_section7(\n312\t                    sec_body, packing, drt, builder.complex_extra.as_ref(), n_decode,\n313\t                )?;\n314\t                // Expand packed values into the full grid using the bitmap (if present).\n315\t                let values = if has_bitmap {\n316\t                    expand_bitmap(packed_values, &builder.bitmap, n_grid)\n317\t                } else {\n318\t builder.grid.clone();\n324\t                let prev_gdt_template = builder.gdt_template;\n325\t                let next_builder = FieldBuilder {\n326\t                    center: builder.center,\n327\t                    subcenter: builder.subcenter,\n328\t                    ref_time: builder.ref_time,\n329\t                    // Preserve grid definition for subsequent fields in multi-field messages\n330\t                    grid: prev_grid,\n331\t                    gdt_template: prev_gdt_template,\n332\t                    ..Default::default()\n333\t                };\n334\t                if let Some(field) = builder.build() {\n335\t                    out.push(field);\n336\t                }\n337\t                builder = next_builder;\n338\t            }\n339\t            _ => { /* Unknown section — skip */ }\n340\t        }\n341\t\n342\t        // Advance buf.pos to the end of this section.\n343\t        buf.pos = sec_start + sec_len;\n344\t    }\n345\t\n346\t    // Consume \"7777\" end marker.\n347\t    let end = &msg[body_end..body_end + 4];\n348\t    if end != b\"7777\" {\n349\t        return Err(Error::TooShort { needed: 4, got: 0 });\n350\t    }\n351\t\n352\t    Ok(total_len)\n353\t}\n354\t\n355\t// ── Section 1: Identification ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n356\t\n357\tfn parse_section1(body: &[u8]) -> Result<(u16, u16, ReferenceTime)> {\n358\t    let mut b = Buf::new(body);\n359\t    // oct 6-7 of section (indices 0-1 in body): originating center\n360\t    let center = b.read_u16be()?;\n361\t    // b.read_u8()?;\n366\t    let year = b.read_u16be()?;\n367\t    let month = b.read_u8()?;\n368\t    let day = b.read_u8()?;\n369\t    let hour = b.read_u8()?;\n370\t    let minute = b.read_u8()?;\n371\t    let second = b.read_u8()?;\n372\t    // production status and type of data — not stored in Field currently\n373\t    Ok((\n374\t        center,\n375\t        subcenter,\n376\t        ReferenceTime { year, month, day, hour, minute, second, significance },\n377\t    ))\n378\t}\n379\t\n380\t// ── Section 3: Grid Definition ────────────────────────────────────────────────\n381\t\n382\tfn parse_section3(body: &[u8]) -> Result<(u16, GridDefinition)> {\n383\t    let mut b = Buf::new(body);\n384\t    b.skip(1)?; // source of grid definition (oct 6)\n385\t    let num_data_points =    }\n413\t}\n414\t\n415\t/// Grid Definition Template 3.0: Latitude/Longitude.\n416\tfn parse_gdt_0(b: &mut Buf, num_data_points: u32) -> Result<GridDefinition> {\n417\t    let shape_of_earth = as f64 / 1_000_000.0;        // oct 52–55: LoV\n641\t\n642\t    // Dx and Dy units depend on bit 5 of resolution_flags (Table 3.3):\n643\t    // 0 = metres, 1 = millimetres\n644\t    let dx_raw = resolution_flags & 0x20 != 0 { dx_raw / 1000.0 } else { dx_raw };\n647\t    let dy_m = if resolution_flags & 0x20 != 0 { dy_raw / 1000.0 } else { dy_raw };\n648\t\n649\t    let proj_centre = b.read_u8()?;       // oct 64\n650\t    let scanning_mode = b.read_u8()?;     // oct 65\n651\t\n652\t    let latin1 = b.read_latlon_micro()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0;    // oct 66–69\n653\t    let latin2 = b.read_latlon_micro()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0;    // oct 70–73\n654\t    let lat_south_pole = b.read_latlon_micro()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0; // oct 74–77\n655\t    let lon_south_pole = b.read_longi_micro()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0;  // oct 78–81\n656\t\n657\t    let projection = GridProjection::LambertConformal(LambertConformalParams {\n658\t        lad, lov, dx_m, dy_m, proj_centre, latin1, latin2, lat_south_pole, lon_south_pole,\n659\t    });\n660\t\n661\t    Ok(GridDefinition {\n662\t        template: 30,\n663\t        num_data_points,\n664\t        nx,\n665\t        ny,\n666\t        lat_first,\n667\t        lon_first,\n668\t        lat_last: 0.0, // not stored in GDT 3.30; derive via projection if needed\n669\t        lon_last: 0.0,\n670\t        di: 0.0,       // increment in metres, stored in LambertConformalParams\n671\t        dj: 0.0,\n672\t        scanning_mode,\n673\t        resolution_flags,\n674\t        shape_of_earth,\n675\t        projection,\n676\t    })\n677\t}\n678\t\n679\t/// Grid Definition Template 3.40: Gaussian Latitude/Longitude.\n680\t///\n681\t/// Byte layout (b starts at section octet 15 = first body byte after template number):\n682\t///\n683\t/// | Octets | Field |\n684\t/// |--------|-------|\n685\t/// | 15     | shape of earth |\n686\t/// | 16–20  | earth radius scale + value (skipped) |\n687\t/// | 21–25  | major-axis scale + value (skipped) |\n688\t/// | 26–30  | minor-axis scale + value (skipped) |\n689\t/// | 31–34  | Nx (Ni) |\n690\t/// | 35–38  | Ny (Nj) |\n691\t/// | 39–42  | basic angle (skipped) |\n692\t/// | 43–46  | basic angle subdivisions (skipped) |\n693\t/// | 47–50  | La1 (signed microdegrees) |\n694\t/// | 51–54  | Lo1 (unsigned microdegrees, 0–360) |\n695\t/// | 55     | resolution/component flags |\n696\t/// | 56–59  | La2 (signed microdegrees) |\n697\t/// | 60–63  | Lo2 (unsigned microdegrees, 0–360) |\n698\t/// | 64–67  | Di (unsigned microdegrees/1e6) |\n699\t/// | 68–71  | N (number of parallels between pole and equator) |\n700\t/// | 72     | scanning mode |\n701\t///\n702\t/// GDT 3.40 differs from GDT 3.0 only in octets 68–71: these hold N (a raw\n703\t/// unsigned 32-bit integer, not scaled) instead of Dj.  Dj is left as 0.0.\n704\tfn parse_gdt_40(b: &mut Buf, num_data_points: u32) -> Result<GridDefinition> {\n705\t    let shape_of_earth = b.read_u8()?;    // oct 15\n706\t    b.skip(1 + 4)?;                       // oct 16–20: earth radius scale + value\n707\t    b.skip(1 + 4)?;                       // oct 21–25: major axis\n708\t    b.skip(1 + 4)?;                       // oct 26–30: minor axis\n709\t\n710\t    let nx = b.read_u32be()?;             // oct 31–34\n711\t    let ny = b.read_u32be()?;             // oct 35–38\n712\t\n713\t    b.skip(4)?;                           // oct 39–42: basic angle\n714\t    b.skip(4)?;                           // oct 43–46: subdivisions\n715\t\n716\t    let lat_first = b.read_latlon_micro()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0; // oct 47–50\n717\t    let lon_first = b.read_longi_micro()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0;  // oct 51–54\n718\t    let resolution_flags = b.read_u8()?;  // oct 55\n719\t    let lat_last  = b.read_latlon_micro()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0; // oct 56–59\n720\t    let lon_last  = b.read_longi_micro()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0;  // oct 60–63\n721\t\n722\t    let di        = b.read_u32be()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0;        // oct 64–67\n723\t    let n_parallels = b.read_u32be()?;                            // oct 68–71 (N, not Dj)\n724\t    let scanning_mode = b.read_u8()?;     // oct 72\n725\t\n726\t    let projection = GridProjection::GaussianLatLon(GaussianLatLonParams { n_parallels });\n727\t\n728\t    Ok(GridDefinition {\n729\t        template: 40,\n730\t        num_data_points,\n731\t        nx,\n732\t        ny,\n733\t        lat_first,\n734\t        lon_first,\n735\t        lat_last,\n736\t        lon_last,\n737\t        di,\n738\t        dj: 0.0,   // not stored in GDT 3.40; N replaces Dj\n739\t        scanning_mode,\n740\t        resolution_flags,\n741\t        shape_of_earth,\n742\t        projection,\n743\t    })\n744\t}\n745\t\n746\t// ── Section 4: Product Definition ────────────────────────────────────────────\n747\t\n748\tfn parse_section4(\n749\t    body: &[u8],\n750\t    discipline: u8,\n751\t) -> Result<(u16, ParameterId, ForecastTime, Level, Option<Ensemble>)> {\n752\t    let mut b = Buf::new(body);\n753\t    let _n_coord = b.read_u16be()?; // oct 6-7: number of coordinate values\n754\t    let template = b.read_u16be()?; // oct 8-9: PDT template number\n755\t\n756\t    match template {\n757\t        0 => {\n758\t            let (param, fore, lvl, ens) = parse_pdt_0(&mut b, discipline)?;\n759\t            Ok((0, param, fore, lvl, ens))\n760\t        }\n761\t        1 => {\n762\t            let (param, fore, lvl, ens) = parse_pdt_1(&mut b, discipline)?;\n763\t            Ok((1, param, fore, lvl, ens))\n764\t        }\n765\t        2 => {\n766\t            // Product Definition Template 4.2: Analysis or forecast at a horizontal level\n767\t            // Same as PDT 4.0 for our purposes (uses common header only)\n768\t            let (param, fore, lvl, ens) = parse_pdt_0(&mut b, discipline)?;\n769\t            Ok((2, param, fore, lvl, ens))\n770\t        }\n771\t        8 => {\n772\t            let (param, fore, lvl, ens) = parse_pdt_8(&mut b, discipline)?;\n773\t            Ok((8, param, fore, lvl, ens))\n774\t        }\n775\t        11 => {\n776\t            let (param, fore, lvl, ens) = parse_pdt_11(&mut b, discipline)?;\n777\t            Ok((11, param, fore, lvl, ens))\n778\t        }\n779\t        _ => Err(Error::NotImplemented),\n780\t    }\n781\t}\n782\t\n783\t/// Parse the common PDT header fields shared by templates 4.0, 4.1, 4.8, 4.11.\n784\t///\n785\t/// Reads octets 10–34 (parameter, time, and level fields).  The caller reads\n786\t/// any template-specific tail octets after calling this function.\n787\tfn parse_pdt_common_header(\n788\t    b: &mut Buf,\n789\t    discipline: u8,\n790\t) -> Result<(ParameterId, ForecastTime, Level)> {\n791\t    let category = b.read_u8()?;  // oct 10\n792\t    let number = b.read_u8()?;    // oct 11\n793\t    b.skip(1)?; // generating process type (oct 12)\n794\t    b.skip(1)?; // background generating process id (oct 13)\n795\t    b.skip(1)?; // analysis/forecast generating process id (oct 14)\n796\t    b.skip(2)?; // hours of cutoff after reference time (oct 15-16)\n797\t    b.skip(1)?; // minutes of cutoff (oct 17)\n798\t    let time_range_unit = b.read_u8()?;    // oct 18\n799\t    let forecast_offset = b.read_u32be()?; // oct 19-22\n800\t\n801\t    let type1 = b.read_u8()?;                     // oct 23\n802\t    let scale_factor1 = b.read_i8()?;             // oct 24\n803\t    let scaled_value1 = b.read_u32be()? as i32;   // oct 25-28\n804\t\n805\t    let raw_type2 = b.read_u8()?;                     // oct 29\n806\t    let raw_scale_factor2 = b.read_i8()?;             // oct 30\n807\t    let raw_scaled_value2 = b.read_u32be()? as i32;   // oct 31-34\n808\t\n809\t    // When second surface type is 255 (missing), zero out its scale/value\n810\t    // to match eccodes behavior.\n811\t    let (type2, scale_factor2, scaled_value2) = if raw_type2 == 255 {\n812\t        (255u8, 0i8, 0i32)\n813\t    } else {\n814\t        (raw_type2, raw_scale_factor2, raw_scaled_value2)\n815\t    };\n816\t\n817\t    let param = ParameterId { discipline, category, number };\n818\t    // Reference time is filled in from Section 1 by the caller.\n819\t    let fore = ForecastTime {\n820\t        reference_time: ReferenceTime {\n821\t            year: 0, month: 0, day: 0, hour: 0, minute: 0, second: 0, significance: 0,\n822\t        },\n823\t        time_range_unit,\n824\t        forecast_offset,\n825\t    };\n826\t    let lvl = Level { type1, scale_factor1, scaled_value1, type2, scale_factor2, scaled_value2 };\n827\t\n828\t    Ok((param, fore, lvl))\n829\t}\n830\t\n831\t/// Product Definition Template 4.0: Analysis or forecast at horizontal level.\n832\tfn parse_pdt_0(\n833\t    b: &mut Buf,\n834\t    discipline: u8,\n835\t) -> Result<(ParameterId, ForecastTime, Level, Option<Ensemble>)> {\n836\t    let (param, fore, lvl) = parse_pdt_common_header(b, discipline)?;\n837\t    Ok((param, fore, lvl, None))\n838\t}\n839\t\n840\t/// Product Definition Template 4.1: Individual ensemble forecast, control and\n841\t/// perturbed, at a horizontal level at a point in time.\n842\t///\n843\t/// WMO GRIB2 Table 4.1:\n844\t/// - Octs 10–34: common header (same as PDT 4.0)\n845\t/// - Oct 35: type of ensemble forecast (Table 4.6)\n846\t/// - Oct 36: perturbation number\n847\t/// - Oct 37: number of forecasts in ensemble\n848\tfn parse_pdt_1(\n849\t    b: &mut Buf,\n850\t    discipline: u8,\n851\t) -> Result<(ParameterId, ForecastTime, Level, Option<Ensemble>)> {\n852\t    let (param, fore, lvl) = parse_pdt_common_header(b, discipline)?;\n853\t\n854\t    let member_type = b.read_u8()?;          // oct 35: Table 4.6\n855\t    let perturbation_number = b.read_u8()?;  // oct 36\n856\t    let _n_ensemble = b.read_u8()?;          // oct 37: number in ensemble (unused by harness)\n857\t\n858\t    let ens = Ensemble { member_type, number: perturbation_number as i16 };\n859\t    Ok((param, fore, lvl, Some(ens)))\n860\t}\n861\t\n862\t/// Product Definition Template 4.8: Average, accumulation, extreme values or\n863\t/// other statistically-processed values at a horizontal level in a continuous\n864\t/// or non-continuous time interval.\n865\t///\n866\t/// WMO GRIB2 Table 4.8:\n867\t/// - Octs 10–34: common header (same as PDT 4.0)\n868\t/// - Oct 35: year (u16), month, day, hour, minute, second of end of interval\n869\t/// - Oct 41: number of time range specifications (n)\n870\t/// - Octs 42 onward: n × 12-byte time range specifications (skipped)\n871\t///\n872\t/// Only the common header fields are surfaced; the statistical window\n873\t/// information is not yet modelled in `ForecastTime`.\n874\tfn parse_pdt_8(\n875\t    b: &mut Buf,\n876\t    discipline: u8,\n877\t) -> Result<(ParameterId, ForecastTime, Level, Option<Ensemble>)> {\n878\t    let (param, fore, lvl) = parse_pdt_common_header(b, discipline)?;\n879\t\n880\t    // End-of-interval timestamp and time-range specs: skip entirely.\n881\t    // Oct 35-40: end time (year u16 + month + day + hour + min + sec = 7 bytes)\n882\t    b.skip(7)?;\n883\t    // Oct 41: number of time range specs\n884\t    let n_ranges = b.read_u8()? as usize;\n885\t    // Each spec is 12 bytes.\n886\t    b.skip(12 * n_ranges)?;\n887\t\n888\t    Ok((param, fore, lvl, None))\n889\t}\n890\t\n891\t/// Product Definition Template 4.11: Individual ensemble member +\n892\t/// time-processed statistical product at a horizontal level.\n893\t///\n894\t/// WMO GRIB2 Table 4.11:\n895\t/// - Octs 10–34: common header (same as PDT 4.0)\n896\t/// - Oct 35: type of ensemble forecast (Table 4.6)\n897\t/// - Oct 36: perturbation number\n898\t/// - Oct 37: number of forecasts in ensemble\n899\t/// - Oct 38-43: end-of-interval timestamp (year u16 + month + day + hour + min + sec)\n900\t/// - Oct 44: number of time range specifications (n)\n901\t/// - Octs 45+: n × 12-byte time range specs (skipped)\n902\tfn parse_pdt_11(\n903\t    b: &mut Buf,\n904\t    discipline: u8,\n905\t) -> Result<(ParameterId, ForecastTime, Level, Option<Ensemble>)> {\n906\t    let (param, fore, lvl) = parse_pdt_common_header(b, discipline)?;\n907\t\n908\t    let member_type = b.read_u8()?;          // oct 35\n909\t    let perturbation_number = b.read_u8()?;  // oct 36\n910\t    let _n_ensemble = b.read_u8()?;          // oct 37\n911\t\n912\t    // Oct 38-43: end-of-interval timestamp (7 bytes: year u16 + month + day + hour + min + sec)\n913\t    b.skip(7)?;\n914\t    // Oct 44: number of time range specs\n915\t    let n_ranges = b.read_u8()? as usize;\n916\t    b.skip(12 * n_ranges)?;\n917\t\n918\t    let ens = Ensemble { member_type, number: perturbation_number as i16 };\n919\t    Ok((param, fore, lvl, Some(ens)))\n920\t}\n921\t\n922\t// ── Section 5: Data Representation ───────────────────────────────────────────\n923\t\n924\tfn parse_section5(body: &[u8]) -> Result<(u16, PackingInfo, Option<ComplexPackingExtra>, usize)> {\n925\t    let mut b = Buf::new(body);\n926\t    let n_values = b.read_u32be()? as usize; // oct 6-9: number of packed values\n927\t    let template = b.read_u16be()?;           // oct 10-11: DRT template number\n928\t\n929\t    match template {\n930\t        0 => {\n931\t            let packing = parse_drt_common(&mut b)?;\n932\t            Ok((0, packing, None, n_values))\n933\t        }\n934\t        2 => {\n935\t            let (packing, extra) = parse_drt_2(&mut b)?;\n936\t            Ok((2, packing, Some(extra), n_values))\n937\t        }\n938\t        3 => {\n939\t            let (packing, extra) = parse_drt_3(&mut b)?;\n940\t            Ok((3, packing, Some(extra), n_values))\n941\t        }\n942\t        40 => {\n943\t            // Template 5.40: JPEG 2000 data compression — same common header as DRT=0.\n944\t            let packing = parse_drt_common(&mut b)?;\n945\t            Ok((40, packing, None, n_values))\n946\t        }\n947\t        41 => {\n948\t            // Template 5.41: PNG data compression — same common header as DRT=0.\n949\t            let packing = parse_drt_common(&mut b)?;\n950\t            Ok((41, packing, None, n_values))\n951\t        }\n952\t        _ => Err(Error::NotImplemented),\n953\t    }\n954\t}\n955\t\n956\t/// Parse the common packing header shared by DRT templates 0, 2, and 3.\n957\tfn parse_drt_common(b: &mut Buf) -> Result<PackingInfo> {\n958\t    let reference_value = b.read_f32be()?;               // oct 12-15: R\n959\t    let binary_scale_factor = b.read_scale_factor_i16()?; // oct 16-17: E\n960\t    let decimal_scale_factor = b.read_scale_factor_i16()?; // oct 18-19: D\n961\t    let bits_per_value = b.read_u8()?;                   // oct 20: N\n962\t    let original_field_type = b.read_u8()?;              // oct 21\n963\t\n964\t    Ok(PackingInfo {\n965\t        reference_value,\n966\t        binary_scale_factor,\n967\t        decimal_scale_factor,\n968\t        bits_per_value,\n969\t        original_field_type,\n970\t    })\n971\t}\n972\t\n973\t/// Data Representation Template 5.2: Complex packing (no spatial differencing).\n974\tfn parse_drt_2(b: &mut Buf) -> Result<(PackingInfo, ComplexPackingExtra)> {\n975\t    let packing = parse_drt_common(b)?;  // oct 12-21: common header\n976\t\n977\t    b.skip(1)?; // oct 22: group splitting method\n978\t    b.skip(1)?; // oct 23: missing value management (0 = none)\n979\t    b.skip(4)?; // oct 24-27: primary missing value\n980\t    b.skip(4)?; // oct 28-31: secondary missing value\n981\t\n982\t    let n_groups = b.read_u32be()?;              // oct 32-35\n983\t    let ref_group_widths = b.read_u8()?;         // oct 36\n984\t    let bits_group_widths = b.read_u8()?;        // oct 37\n985\t    let ref_group_lengths = b.read_u32be()?;     // oct 38-41\n986\t    let length_increment = b.read_u8()?;         // oct 42\n987\t    let true_last_group_length = b.read_u32be()?; // oct 43-46\n988\t    let bits_scaled_group_lengths = b.read_u8()?; // oct 47\n989\t    // Octets 48-49 (order_spatial_diff, extra_octet_count) are absent in template 5.2.\n990\t\n991\t    Ok((packing, ComplexPackingExtra {\n992\t        n_groups,\n993\t        ref_group_widths,\n994\t        bits_group_widths,\n995\t        ref_group_lengths,\n996\t        length_increment,\n997\t        true_last_group_length,\n998\t        bits_scaled_group_lengths,\n999\t        order_spatial_diff: 0,\n1000\t        extra_octet_count: 0,\n1001\t    }))\n1002\t}\n1003\t\n1004\t/// Data Representation Template 5.3: Complex packing with spatial differencing.\n1005\tfn parse_drt_3(b: &mut Buf) -> Result<(PackingInfo, ComplexPackingExtra)> {\n1006\t    let packing = parse_drt_common(b)?;  // oct 12-21: common header\n1007\t\n1008\t    b.skip(1)?; // oct 22: group splitting method\n1009\t    b.skip(1)?; // oct 23: missing value management (0 = none)\n1010\t    b.skip(4)?; // oct 24-27: primary missing value\n1011\t    b.skip(4)?; // oct 28-31: secondary missing value\n1012\t\n1013\t    let n_groups = b.read_u32be()?;              // oct 32-35\n1014\t    let ref_group_widths = b.read_u8()?;         // oct 36\n1015\t    let bits_group_widths = b.read_u8()?;        // oct 37\n1016\t    let ref_group_lengths = b.read_u32be()?;     // oct 38-41\n1017\t    let length_increment = b.read_u8()?;         // oct 42\n1018\t    let true_last_group_length = b.read_u32be()?; // oct 43-46\n1019\t    let bits_scaled_group_lengths = b.read_u8()?; // oct 47\n1020\t    let order_spatial_diff = b.read_u8()?;       // oct 48\n1021\t    let extra_octet_count = b.read_u8()?;        // oct 49\n1022\t\n1023\t    Ok((packing, ComplexPackingExtra {\n1024\t        n_groups,\n1025\t        ref_group_widths,\n1026\t        bits_group_widths,\n1027\t        ref_group_lengths,\n1028\t        length_increment,\n1029\t        true_last_group_length,\n1030\t        bits_scaled_group_lengths,\n1031\t        order_spatial_diff,\n1032\t        extra_octet_count,\n1033\t    }))\n1034\t}\n1035\t\n1036\t// ── Section 6: Bit Map ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n1037\t\n1038\t/// Parse Section 6 (Bit Map).\n1039\t///\n1040\t/// Returns `(has_bitmap, bitmap_bytes)`:\n1041\t/// - `has_bitmap=false, bitmap_bytes=None` when indicator == 255 (all points present).\n1042\t/// - `has_bitmap=true, bitmap_bytes=Some(bytes)` when indicator == 0: one bit per grid\n1043\t///   point, MSB-first packed, length = ceil(n_grid_points / 8).\n1044\tfn parse_section6(body: &[u8]) -> Result<(bool, Option<Vec<u8>>)> {\n1045\t    let mut b = Buf::new(body);\n1046\t    let indicator = b.read_u8()?; // oct 6\n1047\t    match indicator {\n1048\t        255 => Ok((false, None)),\n1049\t        0 => {\n1050\t            // Remaining bytes are the bitmap (1 bit per grid point, MSB first).\n1051\t            let bitmap = body[1..].to_vec();\n1052\t            Ok((true, Some(bitmap)))\n1053\t        }\n1054\t        _ => Err(Error::NotImplemented),\n1055\t    }\n1056\t}\n1057\t\n1058\t// ── Bitmap expansion ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n1059\t\n1060\t/// Expand a vector of packed (present-only) values into a full `n_grid`-length\n1061\t/// masked grid using the bitmap.\n1062\t///\n1063\t/// The bitmap is a packed MSB-first bit array (one bit per grid point). Where\n1064\t/// the bit is 1, the next value from `packed` is used; where 0, the grid point\n1065\t/// is absent (value = 0.0, present = false). Returns `GridValues::Masked` if\n1066\t/// a bitmap is provided and `n_packed < n_grid`, otherwise returns the input\n1067\t/// as a `Dense` grid.\n1068\tfn expand_bitmap(\n1069\t    packed: GridValues,\n1070\t    bitmap: &Option<Vec<u8>>,\n1071\t    n_grid: usize,\n1072\t) -> GridValues {\n1073\t    let bm = match bitmap {\n1074\t        Some(bm) => bm,\n1075\t        None => return packed, // no bitmap — pass through\n1076\t    };\n1077\t\n1078\t    let packed_vals = match packed {\n1079\t        GridValues::Dense(v) => v,\n1080\t        other => return other, // already masked somehow — pass through\n1081\t    };\n1082\t\n1083\t    if packed_vals.len() == n_grid {\n1084\t        // The packed count already matches the grid — no expansion needed.\n1085\t        return GridValues::Dense(packed_vals);\n1086\t    }\n1087\t\n1088\t    let mut values = vec![0.0f64; n_grid];\n1089\t    let mut present = vec![false; n_grid];\n1090\t    let mut packed_idx = 0usize;\n1091\t\n1092\t    for grid_idx in 0..n_grid {\n1093\t        let byte = grid_idx / 8;\n1094\t        let bit = 7 - (grid_idx % 8); The first\n1157\t/// component carries packed integers X; decoded values follow: Y = (R + X × 2^E) / 10^D.\n1158\t#[cfg(feature = \"jpeg2000\")]\n1159\tfn decode_drt40(body: &[u8], packing: &PackingInfo, n_points: usize) -> Result<GridValues> {\n1160\t    let img = jpeg2k::Image::from_bytes(body)\n1161\t        .map_err(|_| Error::InvalidData(\"JPEG2000 decode failed\"))?;\n1162\t    let comp = img.components().first()\n1163\t        .ok_or(Error::InvalidData(\"J2K: no image components\"))?;\n1164\t\n1165\t    let r = packing.reference_value as f64;\n1166\t    let e = packing.binary_scale_factor as i32;\n1167\t    let d = packing.decimal_scale_factor as i32;\n1168\t    let two_e = 2f64.powi(e);\n1169\t    let ten_d = 10f64.powi(d);\n1170\t\n1171\t    let data = comp.data(); // &[i32] — raw packed integer X values\n1172\t    let values: Vec<f64> = data.iter()\n1173\t        .take(n_points)\n1174\t        .map(|&x| (r + x as f64 * two_e) / ten_d)\n1175\t        .collect();\n1176\t\n1177\t    if values.len() < n_points {\n1178\t        return Err(Error::InvalidData(\"J2K: fewer pixels than grid points\"));\n1179\t    }\n1180\t\n1181\t    Ok(GridValues::Dense(values))\n1182\t}\n1183\t\n1184\t/// Decode Template 5.41: PNG data compression.\n1185\t///\n1186\t/// Section 7 contains a raw PNG image. The key savings vs. the\n1434\t/// per-element path:\n1435\t///\n1436\t/// * No `div_ceil` per element — `bytes_needed` is computed once on pre-fill.\n1437\t/// * No inner byte-assembly loop per element — bytes are amortised over a\n1438\t///   window: one byte loaded per 8 bits consumed on average.\n1439\t/// * Single `shift + mask` per value instead of 3–9 byte-load + shift operations.\n1440\t///\n1441\t/// The left-aligned invariant: valid bits always occupy the MSB positions of\n1442\t/// `buf`, so the next `w`-bit value is always extracted as `(buf >> (64 - w)) & mask`.\n1443\t///\n1444\t/// # Panics (debug only)\n1445\t/// `w` must satisfy `0 < w ≤ 32`.  The caller is responsible for the w=0 fast\n1446\t/// path (zero-width groups).\n1447\t#[inline]\n1448\tfn extract_group_windowed(\n1449\t    data: &[u8],\n1450\t    start_bit: usize,\n1451\t    w: usize,\n1452\t    count: usize,\n1453\t    gref: i64,\n1454\t    out: &mut Vec<i64>,\n1455\t) {\n1456\t    debug_assert!(w > 0 && w <= 32, \"w={w} out of range (caller must handle w=0)\");\n1457\t    let mask: u64 = (1u64 << w) - 1;\n1458\t\n1459\t    // `buf` holds up to 64 bits of stream data, left-aligned (MSB = next bit).\n1460\t    // `buf_bits` tracks how many valid bits sit at the top of `buf`.\n1461\t    let mut buf: u64 = 0;\n1462\t    let mut buf_bits: usize = 0;\n1463\t    let mut byte_pos = start_bit / 8;\n1464\t    let skip = start_bit % 8; // alignment bits to discard before the first value\n1465\t\n1466\t    // Inline loader: place data[byte_pos] at the next available MSB position.\n1467\t    // Precondition: buf_bits ≤ 56 (so buf_bits + 8 ≤ 64, no overflow).\n1468\t    // buf_bits stays ≤ 40 in the inner loop (analysis below), so this always holds.\n1469\t    macro_rules! After at most ceil(w/8)\n1495\t    // refills (each adding 8 bits), buf_bits ≤ w + 8*ceil(w/8) ≤ 40 for w ≤ 32.\n1496\t    for _ in 0..count {\n1497\t        // Refill if needed (at most ceil(w/8) ≤ 4 iterations for w ≤ 32).\n1498\t        while buf_bits < w {\n1499\t            load_byte!();\n1500\t        }\n1501\t\n1502\t        // Extract the top w bits and advance the window.\n1503\t        let v = (buf >> (64 - w)) & mask;\n1504\t        buf <<= w;\n1505\t        buf_bits -= w;\n1506\t\n1507\t        out.push(gref + v as i64);\n1508\t    }\n1509\t}\n1510\t\n1511\t/// Read `n_bits` bits from `data` starting at `bit_offset` (MSB-first).\n1512\tfn read_bits_at(data: &[u8], bit_offset: usize, n_bits: usize) -> u64 {\n1513\t    if n_bits == 0 {\n1514\t        return 0;\n1515\t    }\n1516\t    let byte_start = bit_offset / 8;\n1517\t    let bit_start = bit_offset % 8;\n1518\t    let bits_needed = bit_start + n_bits;\n1519\t    let bytes_needed = bits_needed.div_ceil(8);\n1520\t    let mut raw: u64 = 0;\n1521\t    for i in 0..bytes_needed {\n1522\t        let byte = if byte_start + i < data.len() { data[byte_start + i] } else { 0 };\n1523\t        raw = (raw << 8) | byte as u64;\n1524\t    }\n1525\t    let total_bits = bytes_needed * 8;\n1526\t    let shift = total_bits - bit_start - n_bits;\n1527\t    let mask = (1u64 << n_bits) - 1;\n1528\t    (raw >> shift) & mask\n1529\t}\n1530\t\n1531\t/// Extract `count` unsigned integers each `n_bits` wide from `data`.\n1532\t/// Bits are packed MSB-first: the first value occupies bits [0..n_bits-1]\n1533\t/// of the bitstream (bit 0 = MSB of data[0]).\n1534\tfn unpack_n_bits(data: &[u8], count: usize, n_bits: usize) -> Vec<u64> {\n1535\t    if n_bits == 0 {\n1536\t        return vec![0u64; count];\n1537\t    }\n1538\t    // Fast paths for byte-aligned widths — avoids per-element shift/mask\n1539\t    // overhead and exposes the inner loops to compiler auto-vectorization.\n1540\t    match n_bits {\n1541\t        8 => {\n1542\t            let available = count.min(data.len());\n1543\t            let mut v: Vec<u64> = data[..available].iter().map(|&b| b as u64).collect();\n1544\t            v.resize(count, 0);\n1545\t            return v;\n1546\t        }\n1547\t        16 => {\n1548\t            let available = count.min(data.len() / 2);\n1549\t            let mut v: Vec<u64> = data.chunks_exact(2)\n1550\t                .take(available)\n1551\t                .map(|c| u16::from_be_bytes([c[0], c[1]]) as u64)\n1552\t                .collect();\n1553\t            v.resize(count, 0);\n1554\t            return v;\n1555\t        }\n1556\t        32 => {\n1557\t            let available = count.min(data.len() / 4);\n1558\t            let mut v: Vec<u64> = data.chunks_exact(4)\n1559\t                .take(available)\n1560\t                .map(|c| u32::from_be_bytes([c[0], c[1], c[2], c[3]]) as u64)\n1561\t                .collect();\n1562\t            v.resize(count, 0);\n1563\t            return v;\n1564\t        }\n1565\t        _ => {}\n1566\t    }\n1567\t\n1568\t    let mut values = Vec::with_capacity(count);\n1569\t    let mut bit_offset = 0usize;\n1570\t\n1571\t    for _ in 0..count {\n1572\t        let byte_start = bit_offset / 8;\n1573\t        let bit_start = bit_offset % 8;\n1574\t        let bits_needed = bit_start + n_bits;\n1575\t        let bytes_needed = bits_needed.div_ceil(8);\n1576\t\n1577\t        let mut raw: u64 = 0;\n1578\t        for i in 0..bytes_needed {\n1579\t            let byte = if byte_start + i < data.len() { data[byte_start + i] } else { 0 };\n1580\t            raw = (raw << 8) | byte as u64;\n1581\t        }\n1582\t\n1583\t        // raw has bytes_needed * 8 bits, value lives at the top let mask = (1u64 << n_bits) - 1;\n1588\t        values.push((raw >> shift) & mask);\n1589\t\n1590\t        bit_offset += n_bits;\n1591\t    }\n1592\t\n1593\t    values\n1594\t}\n1595\t\n1596\t// ── Lazy / partial decode (DRT=0 only) ───────────────────────────────────────\n1597\t\n1598\t/// Decode a single grid point from a DRT=0 (simple packing) Section 7 body.\n1599\t///\n1600\t/// Returns `None` when `idx` is out of range for the given body length and\n1601\t/// packing, or when `bits_per_value` is non-zero but the bit span for `idx`\n1602\t/// exceeds the body.  Returns a value for all indices when `bits_per_value == 0`\n1603\t/// (constant field).\n1604\tpub fn decode_point_drt0(body: &[u8], packing: &PackingInfo, idx: usize) -> Option<f64> {\n1605\t    let r = packing.reference_value as f64;\n1606\t    let two_e = 2f64.powi(packing.binary_scale_factor as i32);\n1607\t    let ten_d = 10f64.powi(packing.decimal_scale_factor as i32);\n1608\t\n1609\t    if packing.bits_per_value == 0 {\n1610\t        return Some(r / ten_d);\n1611\t    }\n1612\t\n1613\t    let n = packing.bits_per_value as usize;\n1614\t    let bit_offset = idx * n;\n1615\t    let byte_end = (bit_offset + n).div_ceil(8);\n1616\t    if byte_end > body.len() {\n1617\t        return None;\n1618\t    }\n1619\t    let x = read_bits_at(body, bit_offset, n);\n1620\t    Some((r + x as f64 * two_e) / ten_d)\n1621\t}\n1622\t\n1623\t/// Decode all grid values from a DRT=2 or DRT=3 (complex packing) Section 7 body.\n1624\t///\n1625\t/// This is the public entry point for the \"decode-once-extract-many\" pattern:\n1626\t/// decode the full grid once and cache the `Vec<f64>`, then do O(1) index\n1627\t/// lookups for each station.  For DRT=3 (spatial differencing), random access\n1628\t/// is impossible without a full decode because each value depends on all prior\n1629\t/// values in the differencing reversal step.\n1630\t///\n1631\t/// `body` is the raw Section 7 body (from `LazyField::section7_raw`).\n1632\t/// `packing` is from `LazyField::packing`.\n1633\t/// `extra` is from `LazyField::complex_extra` (must be `Some` for DRT=2/3).\n1634\t/// `n_points` is `LazyField::grid.num_data_points as usize`.\n1635\tpub fn decode_all_drt3(\n1636\t    body: &[u8],\n1637\t    packing: &PackingInfo,\n1638\t    extra: &ComplexExtra,\n1639\t    n_points: usize,\n1640\t) -> Result<Vec<f64>> {\n1641\t    match decode_drt3(body, packing, extra, n_points)? {\n1642\t        GridValues::Dense(v) => Ok(v),\n1643\t        GridValues::Masked { values, .. } => Ok(values),\n1644\t    }\n1645\t}\n1646\t\n1647\t/// Extract a single grid point from a DRT=2 or DRT=3 (complex packing) Section 7 body.\n1648\t///\n1649\t/// Decodes the full grid and returns `values[idx]`.\n1650\t///\n1651\t/// **Performance note:** For DRT=3 (spatial differencing), each call decodes\n1652\t/// the entire grid — random access is impossible because each value depends on\n1653\t/// all prior values.  When extracting multiple stations from the same field,\n1654\t/// prefer [`decode_all_drt3`] (decode once, cache, index in O(1)) to avoid\n1655\t/// paying the full-decode cost N fn decode_point_drt3(\n1664\t    body: &[u8],\n1665\t    packing: &PackingInfo,\n1666\t    extra: &ComplexExtra,\n1667\t    n_points: usize,\n1668\t    idx: usize,\n1669\t) -> Option<f64> {\n1670\t    if idx >= n_points {\n1671\t        return None;\n1672\t    }\n1673\t    let values = decode_all_drt3(body, packing, extra, n_points).ok()?;\n1674\t    values.get(idx).copied()\n1675\t}\n1676\t\n1677\t/// Decode all fields lazily — Section 7 data is stored as raw bytes.\n1678\t///\n1679\t/// DRT=0 fields without a bitmap: `section7_raw` is populated; 15\n    b.skip(1 + 4)?;                       // oct 16–20: earth radius scale + value\n    b.skip(1 + 4)?;                       // oct 21–25: major axis\n    b.skip(1 + 4)?;                       //
